en.headline: Woman reports HK$810,000 in gold and cash stolen from Ngau Tau Kok estate flat
en.dek: Police are treating the case as theft after a 41-year-old resident said jewellery worth about HK$500,000 and HK$310,000 in cash had gone missing.
body: A 41-year-old woman reported to police on Sunday that gold jewellery and cash worth about HK$810,000 had been stolen from her flat in Kwai Fai House at Lower Ngau Tau Kok Estate.

Police said the woman, surnamed Lai, reported the loss at about 11:55am. She told officers that jewellery valued at roughly HK$500,000 and cash amounting to HK$310,000 were missing. Of the cash, about HK$230,000 was in Hong Kong dollars, with the remainder in foreign currencies including Japanese yen, Korean won and renminbi.
Officers classified the case as theft and handed it to the Sau Mau Ping district crime unit. No one has been arrested so far, and the investigation is continuing.
Police urged anyone with information to contact them.

zh.headline: 牛頭角下邨女住戶報稱單位失約81萬元金器現金
zh.dek: 警方列作盜竊案處理，41歲姓賴住戶指約值50萬元金器及31萬元現金不翼而飛。
body: 一名41歲姓賴女子周日向警方報案，指其位於牛頭角下邨貴輝樓的單位內，一批約值81萬元的金器及現金失竊。
警方表示，事主於上午約11時55分報案。她稱單位內約值50萬元的金器及31萬元現金不見了。現金中約23萬元為港元，其餘為日圓、韓圜及人民幣等外幣。
警方將案件列作盜竊，交由秀茂坪警區刑事調查隊跟進。目前暫未有人被捕，調查仍在進行中。
警方呼籲市民如有資料，請與警方聯絡。
